title: GraphQL support (Akshath Kothari, 2020 GSoC)
description: From an initial commit in May 2020 to the add-on's activity in 2026, following the GraphQL add-on's commits and changelog.

chapters.title: The Hall of Fame entry and the launch post
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists Akshath Kothari for "GraphQL Support", GSoC, 2020 Summer, with a blog and add-on link. The blog post, dated 2020-08-28 and written by Akshath Kothari, introduces the GraphQL add-on, lists schema import from a file or URL, introspection, query generation and generator options, and says the add-on is early-stage with limited functionality.

evidence.label: Introducing the GraphQL add-on for ZAP

chapters.title: May to August 2020: first commit to first release
chapters.text: The first commit under addOns/graphql is "Initial commit" by Akshath Kothari, dated 2020-05-21; it adds ExtensionGraphQl.java, GraphQlApi.java, a help page and a changelog. Commits by ricekot (the handle the blog post uses) follow: "Add Import from File / URL Dialogs" (2020-06-02), "Add Import Functionality" (2020-06-09), "Add Query Generation Functionality" (2020-07-07) and "Update version and changelog of graphql" (2020-08-28). The changelog dates version 0.1.0 on 2020-08-28 with the features "Import a GraphQL Schema" and "Generate Queries from an imported Schema".

chapters.title: 2020 to 2022: API options, automation, spider integration
chapters.text: Later subjects include "Expose Options through the API" (2020-10-13), "graphql: Add Automation Framework Support" (2021-03-22), "graphql: replace vars in schemaFile" (2022-03-26), "graphql: use Spider add-on" and "graphql: use Form Handler and add parse filter" (both 2022-08-17), and "graphql: remove core spider usage" (2022-10-14).

chapters.title: 2024 to 2026: fingerprinting, introspection imports, limits
chapters.text: "graphql: Add tech detection for GraphQL Engines" is dated 2024-10-23 and "graphql: Support importing introspection responses" 2024-11-09. Further subjects: "graphql: Add Circular Type Reference Detection" (2025-05-04), "graphql: Add statistics" (2025-12-13), "graphql: Support importing introspection response from URL" (2026-02-18) and "graphql: Allow limiting the number of messages imported" (2026-07-21). The changelog lists 0.35.0 on 2026-10-08, so the add-on still exists at HEAD.
